Hi Eric / Veridian accounts team,

Quick intro — I'm Soojin on Redwood's procurement onboarding team. We're kicking off PO setup for the upcoming integration work and need to complete our tax and banking checks before we can issue a PO. Can you please provide the following items by end of week?

- Completed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if foreign). Prefer PDF, signed.
- A bank letter (on bank letterhead) that matches the legal name and EIN/TIN on the tax form.
- Signatory authorization or proof that the person signing the W-9 has authority to bind the vendor. If there is a DBA, please include evidence tying DBA to the legal entity.
- If you have an onboarding portal profile, please complete the structured tax section here: https://app.redwood.com/onboarding/portal/verify?token=abc123

Note: our system flagged an EIN mismatch between the vendor portal entry and the one pulled from a prior purchase. If possible, include any documentation that reconciles the two (prior invoices, IRS notice, or bank account statement). If you anticipate any delays, flag them here and we'll work with legal for alternative evidence.

I'll loop in Jordan (payments) for bank details and Kimberly (tax compliance) if we need escalation.

Thanks — next step after we receive docs is PO issuance (target within 48 hrs of cleared docs).

Best,
Soojin Lee
